analytes.label: Sodium
analytes.what: Salt balance; tracks hydration and fluid shifts.

analytes.label: Potassium
analytes.what: Needed for normal heart rhythm and muscle function.

analytes.label: Calcium
analytes.what: Bone mineral; rises when bone breaks down in microgravity.

analytes.label: Creatinine
analytes.what: Kidney function and muscle mass marker.

analytes.label: Albumin
analytes.what: Main blood protein; reflects nutrition and fluid status.

analytes.label: Lymphocytes
analytes.what: Immune cells that control viruses; stress lowers them.

analytes.label: Neutrophils
analytes.what: First-responder immune cells; rise with stress.

analytes.label: Hematocrit
analytes.what: Share of blood volume that is red cells; shifts with fluid loss.
